text: {"features":[{"name":"Security Motivation","description":"How convincingly the letter explains a genuine desire to work in security engineering rather than in generic software engineering.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"States interest in the role in generic terms without giving a personal reason tied to security work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows some interest in security impact, but the motivation reads mostly as a broad career move or general alignment statement."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives a clear reason for preferring security work, though the rationale is conventional or only lightly developed."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Offers a thoughtful, role-relevant motivation for security engineering that feels grounded in prior experience or an observed security problem."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents a memorable and authentic reason for pursuing security engineering that strongly reinforces fit for preventive, high-leverage security work."}]},{"name":"Team Charter Alignment","description":"How specifically the letter connects the applicant to this team's actual work of security automation, vulnerability handling, AI agents, variant analysis, or secure developer assistance at scale.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Could plausibly be sent to many backend or infrastructure roles because it does not connect to the team's specific charter."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"References security or infrastructure at a high level, but does not engage the team's concrete responsibilities in a meaningful way."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Aligns clearly to one major part of the role, such as vulnerability response, secure development lifecycle work, or AI tooling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Connects experience and interest to several core responsibilities of the team and shows why the fit is practical rather than generic."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates sharp understanding of the team's mandate as organization-scale security automation and clearly links multiple responsibilities to the applicant's background."}]},{"name":"Production Track Record","description":"How strong the letter's evidence is of hands-on experience testing, maintaining, and launching production software over time.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows only baseline professional experience, with short tenure and limited evidence of shipped production systems."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows early-career production experience, but the depth of duration or shipping scope remains modest."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents a solid mid-level record with several years in production environments and some launched services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong production depth through repeated launches, longer tenure, or credible ownership of multiple services."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows extensive production depth by combining sustained experience with substantial repeated delivery, maintenance, and testing of many services."}]},{"name":"Academic Preparation","description":"How strongly the letter's education exceeds or reinforces the role's preferred technical qualifications.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Presents only the minimum bachelor's qualification with no further academic signal."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Presents a bachelor's degree as clearly relevant technical preparation, but does not exceed the minimum credential."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents a master's degree in a relevant technical field."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents a doctoral degree in a relevant technical field."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents a doctoral degree as part of a clearly advanced technical foundation for the role."}]},{"name":"Go Depth","description":"How convincingly the letter shows substantial Go experience relevant to backend systems for this role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Go without indicating meaningful professional depth or centrality."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows some professional Go use, but not as a major working language."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular Go use in production work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents Go as a primary language for backend or infrastructure systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes Go central to major shipped systems and clearly positions the applicant to build the role's Go back-end services."}]},{"name":"Python Depth","description":"How strong the letter's evidence is of professional Python use for tooling, services, or automation relevant to this role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python, or mentions it without enough detail to show real working ability."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python as a secondary skill with limited evidence of practical use."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows recurring Python use for tooling, scripts, or prototypes."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial Python use for production services, automation, or analysis work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates deep Python strength through production-grade services or critical automation layers that other engineers depend on."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic Fluency","description":"How clearly the letter demonstrates strong practical command of data structures and algorithms.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Offers no meaningful evidence of algorithmic skill beyond generic technical competence."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims strength in data structures or algorithms without giving a concrete example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides one clear example of using an algorithm or data structure to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Provides a technically credible example that shows algorithmic thinking materially shaping system design or performance."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes algorithmic fluency feel like a standout strength through especially concrete, role-relevant examples and confident technical framing."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability Automation","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, routing, or similar security workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of automating vulnerability handling."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Speaks about security automation broadly, but without a specific vulnerability workflow example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building basic automation for vulnerability intake or triage."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly explains replacing manual vulnerability handling with classification, routing, prioritization, or deduplication."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents vulnerability workflow automation as a major achievement with concrete pipeline behavior and clear reduction of expert manual toil."}]},{"name":"Security Assessment Ability","description":"How much the letter demonstrates hands-on ability to perform security assessments of systems or services.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no direct evidence of assessing systems for security."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Hints at security review exposure, but does not describe what the applicant actually assessed."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States hands-on assessment work such as threat modeling, code review, or service reviews."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes substantive assessment work across designs or production services and mentions remediation or follow-through."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents security assessment as a practiced capability with multiple assessment forms and a clear attacker-aware or builder-aware lens."}]},{"name":"AI Engineering Experience","description":"How convincingly the letter shows practical experience building and shipping AI or LLM-backed functionality.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no AI experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI interest or exposure without evidence of shipped work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States direct work on AI or LLM-backed features in production."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Couples production AI experience with attention to evaluation, reliability, or hardening."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows strong AI engineering credibility through shipped AI systems plus explicit handling of trustworthiness, failure modes, or operational controls."}]},{"name":"Agentic Systems Design","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates experience designing agent-based systems with controlled autonomy.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of building agentic systems."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agents or autonomous tooling loosely without architectural detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States experience building agentic tooling with separate agent and service components."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes agent architectures with clear roles for Python agents and backend control layers."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows sophisticated agentic design thinking, including bounded autonomy, permissions, logging, auditability, or guardrails between agents and services."}]},{"name":"Independent Security Grounding","description":"How much the letter shows security depth beyond ordinary software work through certifications, CTF participation, or other hands-on adversarial practice.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no independent security signal beyond ordinary software engineering experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Adds a light signal such as a baseline certification or casual security practice, but with limited depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows ongoing independent security engagement through regular CTF participation or a relevant certification."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Provides a strong hands-on signal such as OSCP or notably serious competitive CTF involvement."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Combines multiple strong independent signals, or otherwise demonstrates unusually serious hands-on security practice beyond day-to-day job duties."}]},{"name":"Platform Leverage Mindset","description":"How strongly the letter values building foundational systems whose benefits scale across many teams or products.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frames the role mostly as another engineering job without a central-platform or multiplier perspective."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Hints at broad impact, but keeps the case mostly generic."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly values work that helps multiple teams or products."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explicitly emphasizes foundational infrastructure or central tooling as a primary source of motivation."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes organization-wide leverage a core through-line, showing deep fit for building security systems whose benefits compound across a company."}]},{"name":"Developer Enablement Mindset","description":"How well the letter shows a philosophy of making secure behavior easy for developer teams rather than adding friction or policing them.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not address how the work would help developer teams."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions helping others only vaguely or in a process-heavy way."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a clear desire to reduce manual work or support developers through better tools."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explicitly frames security as secure defaults, reduced friction, or automation that helps developers succeed."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Repeatedly treats developer enablement as the right model for security, showing strong conviction that good tooling should help rather than police engineers."}]},{"name":"Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration","description":"How clearly the letter signals readiness to work closely with information security engineers and other domain specialists.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention working with security specialists or other partner functions."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Implies teamwork in general, but not the specific collaboration this role requires."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explicitly mentions working alongside security engineers or learning from domain experts."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows enthusiasm for close partnership with security specialists and makes that collaboration part of the value proposition."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents cross-disciplinary work as a natural operating mode, making clear how software engineering and security expertise would reinforce each other in the applicant's approach."}]},{"name":"Evidence Specificity","description":"How concrete and observable the letter's claims are, using real systems, actions, and contexts rather than generic assertions.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on broad claims with little observable detail."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes a few concrete details, but leaves many important claims abstract."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides several specific examples of technologies, tasks, or projects."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Grounds most major claims in concrete systems, actions, or technical contexts."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is consistently specific, with nearly every important claim anchored in identifiable work, mechanisms, or examples."}]},{"name":"Impact Articulation","description":"How well the letter explains the results or value created by the applicant's work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Lists activities without explaining what changed or why it mattered."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Suggests positive outcomes, but gives little concrete sense of value."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Names clear results such as time saved, manual work reduced, better performance, or improved reliability."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Ties multiple examples to meaningful outcomes for teams or systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Repeatedly converts work into vivid, credible impact at team or organizational scale."}]},{"name":"Open-Source Contribution","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates contribution to or maintenance of open-source software as evidence of engineering maturity.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of contributing to open source."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions open source only as a user or with unclear contribution depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes occasional patches or upstream fixes."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows sustained contribution or maintenance responsibility for a project others use."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates significant open-source leadership, such as maintaining a project with external users, reviewing contributions, or managing releases."}]},{"name":"Personal Project Sophistication","description":"How much the letter uses self-directed side projects to demonstrate technical depth, curiosity, or systems design ability.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no personal project evidence."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions only a small, simple side project with little technical ambition."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Includes a credible side project that shows curiosity or follow-through."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes a technically substantial self-directed build, especially in infrastructure or distributed systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Uses a major personal build to demonstrate uncommon rigor, systems depth, and willingness to tackle hard engineering problems independently."}]},{"name":"Writing Polish","description":"How polished the letter's language is, including spelling, grammar, and overall proofreading quality.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent spelling or grammar errors that distract from meaning and materially weaken professionalism."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Contains several noticeable errors or awkward phrases that interrupt reading."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Has some errors, but remains clear and generally professional."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is mostly clean and polished with only minor slips."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is effectively error-free and reads as carefully proofread throughout."}]},{"name":"Narrative Coherence","description":"How well the letter is organized into a clear, persuasive progression rather than a loose list of qualifications.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads like a loose list of claims with weak progression or little narrative shape."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has a basic structure, but feels mechanical, repetitive, or choppy."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Follows a clear motivation-to-qualification arc without major confusion."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Flows well, with experiences introduced in an order that steadily strengthens the case for fit."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Creates a compelling narrative arc in which motivation, experience, and role fit reinforce each other from start to finish."}]}]}
